rationale: Peter's work on clinical-grade diagnostics through mobile health and wearables AI complements Chris's deep expertise in open-source autonomous systems and maker culture—two adjacent frontiers in democratizing advanced technology. While Peter focuses on AI and deep learning for health applications, Chris's conviction that open platforms drive innovation and his hands-on robotics background could inform how Azumio scales its wearable hardware and embedded systems. Both are based in Palo Alto and have built technical communities around their respective domains.
intro_message: Peter Kuhar, meet Chris Anderson — you're both building in AI-driven hardware ecosystems and share convictions about open platforms and maker culture accelerating innovation in their respective fields.
